title: Integrate JACUSA2 call-1 (RNA variants vs reference genome)
description: Add JACUSA2 call-1 (single-condition variant calling vs reference genome) as a per-sample tool in the Morales_et_al benchmark pipeline, and wire it into the cross-tool comparison (compare_all_tools.py + compare_outputs.py) alongside reditools/sprint/red_ml/bcftools/redinet. call-1 runs on rmdup_MD.bam per condition/sample; bases11 base counts yield per-site coverage and editing fraction plus the JACUSA2 score.
close_reason: JACUSA2 call-1 integrated as per-sample tool in Morales_et_al: new rule, compare_all_tools/compare_outputs/tool_output_to_bed parsers, wired into _BED_TOOLS + configs. Verified via unit tests + full dry-run.

title: JACUSA2 downstream labels: use real condition names, not hard-coded WT/ADAR1KO
description: JACUSA2.py exports under literal keys 'WT'/'ADAR1KO' positionally (bases1*->'WT', bases2*->'ADAR1KO') and Multiple-Analysis.py hard-codes conditions=['WT','ADAR1KO'] + panel labels 'WT condition'/'ADAR1KO condition' + 'if condition==ADAR1KO'. So config1=ADAR1KO/config2=WT yields swapped/mislabeled panels. Fix: patcher rewrites both scripts to use real condition1/condition2 names (bases1*=condition1, bases2*=condition2) when JACUSA2 enabled. Disabled path unchanged.
close_reason: Patcher now re-keys JACUSA2.py export and relabels Multiple-Analysis.py (conditions list, panel titles, panel assignment) with real condition1/condition2 names (swap-safe sentinels). bases1*=condition1, bases2*=condition2. Validated: transforms py_compile for default+swapped, dry-run enabled-default/enabled-swapped/disabled all 0 errors.

title: Make JACUSA2 optional via config differential-condition; skip when absent
description: rule jacusa2 (tools.smk) hard-codes WT_/ADAR1KO_ BAM groups; JACUSA2 outputs are always in rule all and always parsed. Add optional config key jacusa2_comparison:{condition1,condition2}. When present: rule jacusa2 contrasts those two condition groups, and JACUSA2 targets (Jacusa.out, Data_JACUSA2.json, JACUSA2_Table.csv) are produced. When absent: skip JACUSA2 entirely (not in rule all, not staged/parsed; Multiple-Analysis.py must not require Data_JACUSA2.json). Depends on parser fix.
close_reason: Fixed: HISAT2 idempotent chr-prepend + JACUSA2 dropna(how=all)+fillna via runtime patcher; JACUSA2 gated on config jacusa2_comparison (skip when absent). Validated: patch transforms py_compile, real-data WT/KO recovered (2->4.5M differing rows), dry-run enabled=3 jacusa jobs / disabled=0 jacusa refs.

title: Fix JACUSA2 parser collapsing WT==ADAR1KO (drops differential sites)
description: JACUSA2.py _preprocess_jacusa_raw: dropna(subset=['wt','adarko']) drops any site where one condition lacks an ALT base - exactly the WT-edited/KO-unedited ADAR signal. Combined with <=2-distinct-base filter, every surviving site has identical dominant edit in both conditions -> WT and ADAR1KO rows byte-identical (verified 0/5683 rows differ). Fix via patcher: dropna(how='all') + fillna('') so single-condition sites are retained and counted toward the correct condition. Keep submodule pristine.
close_reason: Fixed: HISAT2 idempotent chr-prepend + JACUSA2 dropna(how=all)+fillna via runtime patcher; JACUSA2 gated on config jacusa2_comparison (skip when absent). Validated: patch transforms py_compile, real-data WT/KO recovered (2->4.5M differing rows), dry-run enabled=3 jacusa jobs / disabled=0 jacusa refs.

title: Fix HISAT2 double-chr prefix in downstream parsers (0% REDIportal artifact)
description: Downstream parsers BCFtools.py:60-61, REDItools2.py:35, SPRINT.py:36 unconditionally prepend 'chr' for the hisat2 aligner (line[0]='chr'+line[0]). HISAT2 was aligned to a chr-prefixed reference, so raw beds already have chr1 -> becomes chrchr1 -> zero overlap with REDIportal/Alu/HEK293T DB. Result: every HISAT2 REDIportal/Alu/SNP column is artificially 0 for BCFTools, REDItools2/3, SPRINT. Proof: RED-ML/JACUSA2 parsers lack this line and report correct nonzero HISAT2 numbers. Fix via the runtime patcher in rules/morales_downstream.smk: make the prepend idempotent (only prepend when not already startswith chr). Keep submodule pristine.
close_reason: Fixed: HISAT2 idempotent chr-prepend + JACUSA2 dropna(how=all)+fillna via runtime patcher; JACUSA2 gated on config jacusa2_comparison (skip when absent). Validated: patch transforms py_compile, real-data WT/KO recovered (2->4.5M differing rows), dry-run enabled=3 jacusa jobs / disabled=0 jacusa refs.

title: Smoke-test bcftools dbSNP/simpleRepeat exclusion + INFO/DP filter on a real run
description: Part A added to rules/tools.smk bcftools rule: 'bcftools call -mv -Ou | bcftools view -e INFO/DP<{min_cov} -T ^{exclude}', plus new prepare_editing_filters rule (references.smk) building results/references/editing_exclude.bed. Caller FLAGS are now verified correct vs container --help (reditools2 -l=MIN_COLUMN_LENGTH, reditools3 -l=MIN_READ_DEPTH, jacusa2 -c/-q, REDItoolDnaRna -c/-q/-m comma-pairs). NOT yet verified end-to-end: (1) INFO/DP present after 'bcftools call' so -e fires; (2) editing_exclude.bed (sorted via bedtools sort -faidx) ordered to match VCF for streaming -T ^ exclusion. Run prepare_editing_filters + bcftools on the small example; confirm dbSNP/repeat sites are actually dropped (diff counts with/without -T). Real SIFs + small-example inputs present in checkout.
notes:
SMOKE-TESTED 2026-05-31 on small example (hisat2 WT_clone1.rmdup.bam).
BUG FOUND + FIXED: prepare_editing_filters 'bedtools sort -faidx' aborted (exit 1) on alt/random contigs in the UCSC dbSNP table (e.g. chr10_GL383545v1_alt) that are absent from the no-alt analysis-set .fai -> empty editing_exclude.bed, rule fails, bcftools rule blocked. Fix applied in references.smk: filter combined BED to .fai contigs (awk 'NR==FNR{ok[$1]=1;next}($1 in ok)') before the faidx sort. Verified: 75,641,679 -> 74,871,389 rows after filter -> 7,572,017 merged regions, correctly sorted chr1..chrUn.
VERIFIED both filters fire: INFO/DP present after 'bcftools call' (header ID=DP found); n_all=250 -> n_after_DP<5=22 -> n_after_DP+exclude(-T ^bed)=20. -T ^exclude.bed accepted, no ordering error. Remaining: run the full prepare_editing_filters + bcftools rules through Snakemake to confirm wiring end-to-end (this test ran the shell logic directly).

title: Record verified edit-caller flags (spec VERIFY -> VERIFIED)
description: Container --help verification done 2026-05-31 vs real SIFs. Confirmed CORRECT: reditools2 (-bq base-q, -q read-q, -l MIN_COLUMN_LENGTH); reditools3 'reditools analyze' (-bq def30, -q, -l MIN_READ_DEPTH=coverage); jacusa2 call-2 (-q MIN-BASQ, -c MIN-COVERAGE); REDItoolDnaRna.py (-c/-q/-m as dna,rna comma-pairs, used as 0,{val}). Update docs/specs/intersect_correlation.md section 4 from VERIFY to VERIFIED, and note in docs/edit_calling_parameters.md the per-tool semantics (reditools2 -l=column length vs reditools3 -l=read depth, both = per-position coverage) so the next reader doesn't re-flag it.

title: compare_outputs.py: write stub outputs for empty aligners (avoid missing-output failure)
description: scripts/compare_outputs.py process_aligner() does 'if not tools: print(...); return' -> returns WITHOUT writing the 6 per-aligner files the compare_outputs rule declares. If stream_records finds no columns for an aligner, Snakemake fails with 'missing output files'. Won't trigger when all aligners produce tool output (normal case), but is latent fragility. Fix: write empty/stub TSVs for that aligner instead of returning. Verified working on real small-example matrices (reditools~reditools3 site_fraction r=0.991), so this is hardening, not a live break.
